name: Vulture Raider
flavour: He waits for you to tire. Then he waits a little less.
art_prompt: a vulture raider: a tall lean bird-man with a bald wrinkled bright pink vulture head and neck, a hooked pale yellow beak, small fierce angry eyes under a heavy frown, big dark brown feathered wings folded at his back, a thick cream-white shaggy fur ruff round his neck and shoulders, cream fur cuffs at his wrists and knees, a ragged dark brown feather kilt over a cream fur skirt, a brown leather strap across his pink muscular chest, a rusty spiked leather pauldron on his left shoulder, a brown belt with a round brass buckle and a leather pouch, pink bony bird legs with grey scaly taloned feet, and in his right hand an olive-green rocket launcher tube held up at his shoulder with yellow and black hazard stripes and an empty open black muzzle ringed in red, no rocket in it
motion: walking in place with heavy steady strides like a soldier, the rocket launcher held still up at his shoulder in his right hand the whole time, the wings folded
back_hint: seen from behind: his big dark brown feathered wings folded at his back, the back of his bald pink head and neck, the cream fur ruff, the spiked pauldron on his left shoulder, the olive launcher held up at his right shoulder seen from behind, no face, no beak
dead_hint: lying dead sideways across the picture, his pink head on the left and his taloned feet on the right, his wings spread limp on the ground, the launcher dropped beside him
doc: A vulture with a rocket launcher (Garry's picture): keeps 28 m off and sends one slow homing rocket at the hero, then reloads; kill him and the rocket goes loose and dives on the crowd. Every hit on him shakes his rocket and halves its speed, back to full over 3 s (pass 73).
anim_negative: a rocket in the launcher, a missile, a shell, flames, smoke, the launcher swinging, the launcher moving, extra arms, a second launcher, flying, wings flapping, a human face
